steps.title: Chats that run on your PC
steps.body: A new chat can run on one of your worker PCs instead of the server: Claude Code runs there, with that PC's own sign-in, and the chat shows here like any other, with every Crundi tool. Its changes come back to a branch on the server for you to merge. If the PC drops off, the chat waits and carries on when it is back.

steps.title: Watch a build on your PC
steps.body: When a chat runs a command on one of your PCs, a card in the chat shows it live: which PC, the output as it streams, Cancel, and the files that came back. The PC itself tells you when a job or a chat starts and ends.

steps.title: Factory steps on a PC
steps.body: A person in a factory's team, or a single step, can run on one of your PCs: set Runs on in the Team panel or the step. If that PC goes offline, its steps wait (and a Manager on it pauses the run) and carry on when it is back; its work comes back before the step hands off.

steps.title: Only when you are away
steps.body: Each PC in the Workers tab has two more settings: start jobs only after the PC has been idle for a while, and not while it runs on battery. Jobs already run at low priority, so the PC stays yours.
